diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The Statement identifies the exact-sequence stack and two maps used by Hall convolution, and the body proves their distinct geometric properties (q smooth with relative dimension; p representable proper). A small span makes the input/output order and geometric role of each map quick to inspect.
diagram_candidates.specific_content_to_draw: Draw the span M_a × M_b ←^{q} E_{a,b} →^{p} M_{a+b}. Label the E_{a,b} point as a short exact sequence 0→M_a→E→M_b→0 (subobject dimension a, quotient dimension b); label q as “subobject, quotient” and p as “forget filtration / total object”. Do not make the two legs a commutative square or reverse the a,b order.
diagram_candidates.certainty: optional candidate; maps and subobject/quotient order are explicit and confirmed in the source, but no omission defect is confirmed.
